name: Luxury Icons
desc: The healthiest brands when it comes to credibility and premiumness, but they also face the most pressure and scrutiny.

name: Elite Trusted Brands
desc: Developers at the forefront of the market have proved and maintained their premium status over the years.

name: Delivery Masters
desc: They aim to deliver a moderate, but reliable upgrade and serve as the best entry point to gated community developments for consumers.

name: Mass Market Giants
desc: Reliable and consistent delivery of basic products that cater to the widest audience and casts the biggest net.

name: Public Housing / Government Development
desc: A gated-community developer might never be seen in this zone, as it signals the brand is targeting C–D economic classes.

name: Intangible Premium
desc: Developers with unclear positioning that are under observation until their long-term strategy is clearer.

name: Vulnerable Premium
desc: The zone brands enter when new to the market or when they have lost equity. Brands here are on the verge of struggling.

name: Lacks an Edge
desc: With moderate credibility and low premium, these brands fail to stand out and separate themselves from the noise.

name: They Only Talk The Talk
desc: A danger zone that signals a critical mismatch between where the brand aims to be and what the market believes its claims to be.

name: Warning Signal
desc: Struggling brands that many customers actively avoid — brand reputation is close to being a liability.

name: Critical Risk
desc: Developers in the double-negative scores need to prioritize solving existing issues rather than expanding, launching, and accruing a bigger backlog.
